context: A rural local recommends a country restaurant to a city mom
purpose: Teach: 鶏/調理/放題/代金/飲食/定員/ピーク/支払う

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お母さん、東京から来たんやろ？この辺なら、川沿いの飲食店がええよ。
lines.en: Ma'am, you came from Tokyo, right? Around here, the restaurant by the river is great.
lines.style: Warm rural greeting, friendly and welcoming tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、そうなんですか。子供連れでも入れるお店ありますかね？
lines.en: Oh, is that so? Is there a place we can enter even with kids?
lines.style: Polite city mother, slightly cautious and curious.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: もちろん。地元の鶏を使った料理が名物で、調理してるおじさんも気さくな人やよ。
lines.en: Of course. Dishes using local chicken are the specialty, and the cook is a friendly man.
lines.style: Proud local recommending, casual countryside warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 美味しそう！うちの子、たくさん食べるから、食べ放題とかあると助かるんですけど。
lines.en: Sounds delicious! My kid eats a lot, so all-you-can-eat would really help.
lines.style: Relieved hopeful mom, slightly laughing while speaking.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: あるある、平日のお昼なら千五百円で食べ放題。代金もお手頃やろ？
lines.en: Yes, yes — weekday lunch is fifteen hundred yen all-you-can-eat. The price is reasonable, right?
lines.style: Enthusiastic local persuading proudly with countryside charm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 安いですね！でも混んでたりしませんか？席の定員とか気になって。
lines.en: That's cheap! But isn't it crowded? I'm worried about the seating capacity.
lines.style: Practical mom, planning ahead carefully, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ピーク時はちょっと待つけど、一時過ぎに行けば大丈夫やで。支払うのは現金だけやから注意してな。
lines.en: At peak time you wait a bit, but after one o'clock it's fine. Just note they only take cash.
lines.style: Helpful insider tip, casual and informative.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ありがとうございます！早速、お昼に行ってみますね。
lines.en: Thank you so much! We'll head there for lunch right away.
lines.style: Grateful city mother, warm and sincere closing.
